title: Excavations in Palestine and Trans-Jordan, 1936-7: Bethlehem
author: (round-up; Wellcome-Marston expedition, E. W. Gardner and D. M. A. Bate)
location_note: Bone-bearing gravel pit at Bethlehem; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Geological and palaeontological excavation of Pleistocene gravels (giant tortoise, rhinoceros, hippopotamus, Stegodon, Hipparion etc.) and possible eolithic cherts. No eligible feature.
